Measured, recurring, currently tracked only by prose in a closed card's workflow header — and the damage radius is every seat's label writes (a silently-erased `skip-changeset` turns into a false changeset-check red on a PR that publishes nothing). Dispatch note: direction 1 is the fix the workflow header itself names (replace the whole-set `PUT` labelers with a small additive step); direction 2 (post-settle re-apply) is acceptable as a rider, not as the fix. This is gate-strengthening in `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`, no contract face. M, `mode:subagent`, opus; Clause-②: no. Sibling: #10686 keeps the permission-classifier half (routed to the skills lane).
